keyFindings.description: TestRolesHeldByFollowsTheRoleClaims says 'a claim this registry writes itself is in the view as soon as its write answers', but cannot reliably fail without that: with setOwnRoleHolder dropped it fails 7 of 30 runs, with forgetRoleHolder dropped 0 of 30, because the watcher usually delivers first. Hold the watcher's delivery while SetRole and Remove answer, as the refill test does.

TestARecreatedRoleBucketsViewAnswersOnlyOnceItsRefillCompletes (and roles_from_claims_test.go's recreated-bucket case) says the reset empties the view, but both put the same claims back at higher revisions, so a resetRoleHolders that keeps holders or holderRevisions passes. Leave one old claim out of the new bucket, and write an old claim at a revision above the new one.

TestCompleteIsTheCurrentWatchersFirstScanDeliveringEveryKey's comment says the new watcher is complete only once its own scan is; the test checks only that the generation moved and completeness returns (a watch() that stops clearing complete passes it).

The /healthz bullet (:1976) and CHANGELOG (:999-1001) give a stopped role watcher's body as 'interest KV unavailable: role claims watcher stopped'. /healthz checks WatchErr first and labels it 'interest KV watcher' (main.go:411-415), so the body is 'interest KV watcher unavailable: role claims watcher stopped'.
